thread:
elaine: Morning team — quick release train check. Cut window opens in ~1h. Head is v0.42.3-rc.1. Cherries pending: perf backport, rolling-restart fix, docs update. Blockers: flaky e2e on canary (Sanjay) and telemetry QA not signed off.

mike: Picking up the perf backport PR (#2745). Running local perf passes now, will post results in 30m.

sanjay: Investigating the e2e flakes. Repro on gke-staging with latest image — timeout in /tests/serve_endpoints.py. Suspect race in startup probes.

ci-bot: CI summary: flaky tests +2 in last 12h. Retrying failed job build/5678. Will post status.

olivia: QA on telemetry is delayed — analytics team needs a small reproducer. ETA for sign-off ~15:00 PT.

kim: Suggest we hold the canary until e2e stabilized. Also recommend we enable fallback model variant for a short window if latency spikes.

elaine: Agree on holding canary. I'll mark freeze in the release calendar for 30m. Can someone run a manual smoke after the fix lands?

mike: I can run the smoke in ~40m. Allocating a Dedicated agent and will share logs here.

sanjay: Found the culprit — readiness probe racing with cache warmup. Pushing hotfix branch fix/readiness-wait and will open a small PR.

elaine: If you can include a one-liner in the PR body about the mitigation, that helps QA.

sanjay: PR opened: #2751. Patch includes `sleep_until_cache_ready()` + extra timeout on readiness.

ci-bot: Retest triggered for PR #2751. Jobs: unit, integ, e2e (staging).

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: deploy/canary -> staging, user: sanjay, expected duration: 12m.

olivia: I'll watch QA once the staging canary is up. Tagging the telemetry PR with `needs-qa` — @kim can you pair later?

kim: Yep I can join at 14:30 PT and help verify telemetry. :thumbsup:

elaine: Great. If smoke passes, we lift the hold and proceed with the small set of cherries. If not, we rollback to previous rc and reopen investigation. Keep updates short here — thanks everyone.
